story.title: Krutrim Pivots to AI Cloud Services, Reports 3x Revenue Growth and First Net Profit in FY26
story.summary: Krutrim, India's first AI unicorn, has announced a strategic pivot to become a focused domestic AI Cloud Services provider, reporting its first annual net profit in FY26 alongside threefold revenue growth. The company's platform is built entirely in-house and now serves over 25 large enterprise customers across multiple sectors. This marks a significant shift from a broad AI model developer to a sustainable, infrastructure-led cloud business — a milestone for India's homegrown AI industry.
